title: MATLAB: Import and clean the marriage data

cues.en: Instructor: So here we are in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 講師：現在來到 MATLAB。

cues.en: As a reminder, if you are following along in Python, there's no Python in this or the next videos.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，如果你跟著 Python 做，這部和接下來幾部影片都沒有 Python。

cues.en: You want to skip forward a couple of videos, until you see the video title that starts with Python.
cues.zh: 你可以往後跳幾部，直到看到標題以 Python 開頭的影片。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have the URL for the dataset.
cues.zh: 這裡是資料集的網址。

cues.en: So you can see these are just Excel files that are posted directly on the CDC website.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這些只是直接放在 CDC 網站上的 Excel 檔案。

cues.en: So A URL for the marriage dataset and for the divorce dataset.
cues.zh: 一個是結婚資料集的網址，一個是離婚資料集的網址。

cues.en: So now we just have those as character arrays and I'm gonna start by importing the marriage data.
cues.zh: 現在把它們存成字元陣列，先匯入結婚資料。

cues.en: So it turns out that when you import an Excel data file from the internet, from the web, using this function webread, MATLAB is going
cues.zh: 從網路匯入 Excel 資料檔時，使用 webread 這個函式，MATLAB 會

cues.en: to return a data type table.
cues.zh: 傳回 table 資料型別。

cues.en: Now, I've already introduced you to this data type table before in the regression section.
cues.zh: 先前在迴歸那一節，我已經介紹過 table 資料型別。

cues.en: So the videos on regression and also multi-way ANOVA's, we used data tables.
cues.zh: 迴歸與多因子 ANOVA 的影片中，我們都使用過資料表。

cues.en: However, I find it more useful to convert to a cell and then I'm later going to convert to just regular numeric matrices.
cues.zh: 不過，我覺得先轉成 cell 比較方便，之後再轉成一般的數值矩陣。

cues.en: So I import the data and then I convert it from a table into a cell.
cues.zh: 因此，先匯入資料，再從 table 轉成 cell。

cues.en: And this gives me the data.
cues.zh: 這樣就取得資料。

cues.en: And let's have a look at these data.
cues.zh: 來看看這些資料。

cues.en: Let's see what this matrix looks like.
cues.zh: 看看這個矩陣是什麼樣子。

cues.en: So we can see there's a bunch of NaNs and there's a bunch of numbers and yeah, so on.
cues.zh: 可以看到，有一堆 NaN，也有一堆數字等等。

cues.en: So you can see that some of these numbers are strings and some of these, or I should say some of these cell elements are character arrays, and so strings, and some of them are actual numbers.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，有些數字是字串；更精確地說，有些 cell 元素是字元陣列，也就是字串，有些則是真正的數值。

cues.en: So this is a little bit of a hassle, it's kind of annoying.
cues.zh: 這有點麻煩，也有點惱人。

cues.en: We're gonna have to deal with this.
cues.zh: 我們必須處理。

cues.en: Also, the years, you can see this year is characters and this year is a number.
cues.zh: 另外，年份也是如此，你可以看到這個年份是字元，這個年份是數字。

cues.en: So we're going to have to deal with that when we import the data.
cues.zh: 因此，匯入資料時也必須處理。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm here initializing the data matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡我先初始化資料矩陣。

cues.en: Now this is some hard coding that I have in here, but that was done based on what I know about these data.
cues.zh: 這裡有一些寫死在程式中的數值，但都是根據我對這份資料的了解而設定。

cues.en: So there's 51 states, that's all 50 states, plus the District of Columbia, Washington, D.C., So 51, and then there were 23 years.
cues.zh: 有 51 個州級地區，也就是全部 50 州，加上哥倫比亞特區、華盛頓特區，所以是 51；另外有 23 個年份。

cues.en: So this is our data matrix.
cues.zh: 這就是我們的資料矩陣。

cues.en: Now, to convert from the cell into the- into a numeric matrix is, as I just mentioned, a little bit of a hassle because sometimes the data are numeric
cues.zh: 就像剛才提到的，從 cell 轉成數值矩陣有點麻煩，因為有時資料是數值，

cues.en: and sometimes they are string.
cues.zh: 有時則是字串。

cues.en: So what I am doing here is extracting one cell of data and then testing whether it is numeric, in which case we can just plop it right into the data matrix.
cues.zh: 所以我在這裡取出一個 cell 的資料，再測試是不是數值；如果是，就可以直接放進資料矩陣。

cues.en: Or here I'm putting it into the vector of years.
cues.zh: 或者，這裡是放進年份向量。

cues.en: And if it's not numeric, so this is false, then I have to convert it from a string into a double.
cues.zh: 如果不是數值，也就是這個判斷為 false，就必須把它從字串轉成 double。

cues.en: So into a number, floating point precision.
cues.zh: 也就是轉成浮點精度的數值。

cues.en: Now this is not code that, you know, just, (chuckles) you know, CDC didn't provide me with this MATLAB code.
cues.zh: 這段程式可不是，CDC 並沒有提供這份 MATLAB 程式給我。

cues.en: This is something that, you know, it took me several minutes to sit down and think about and figure out.
cues.zh: 這是我自己坐下來花了幾分鐘思考、摸索出來的。

cues.en: But this is the kind of thing that you will often have to work through when you are working with actual data, with real data.
cues.zh: 但在處理真正的資料時，你經常必須自己想辦法處理這類事情。

cues.en: You know, importing data and converting data can often be a little bit of a hassle.
cues.zh: 匯入資料與轉換資料，往往會有點麻煩。

cues.en: Okay, so same thing here, so this is importing all of the rows, and this is for importing all the data.
cues.zh: 這裡也是一樣，這是匯入所有列，這裡則是匯入所有資料。

cues.en: So now we loop over all of the columns, which correspond to years, and we loop over all the rows, which correspond to states.
cues.zh: 現在用迴圈走過所有欄，欄對應年份，再走過所有列，列對應各州。

cues.en: Now how do I know that it's rowi+6?
cues.zh: 我怎麼知道要用 rowi+6？

cues.en: How do I know that I need the rowi element + 6.
cues.zh: 怎麼知道需要 rowi 這個元素再加 6？

cues.en: Again, that's something that I figured out through a bit of trial and error and a bit of looking at the Excel file to see how the data were organized.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這是透過一些嘗試，再看看 Excel 檔案中的資料如何排列而找出來的。

cues.en: Okay, so long story short, then here we also import all the states.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡也匯入所有州名。

cues.en: Long story short, run this cell of code, and that populates our vector of years.
cues.zh: 簡單來說，執行這個程式區塊，就會填入年份向量。

cues.en: This yearM for marriage, 'cause we're working with the marriage data.
cues.zh: yearM 的 M 代表 marriage，因為正在處理結婚資料。

cues.en: And then we get the matrix M, which is states by years, and then we have the cell array corresponding to all of these states.
cues.zh: 接著得到矩陣 M，是州乘以年份，另外還有對應所有州名的 cell 陣列。

cues.en: Okay, so let's, so now we need just to look at the data and start cleaning the data a little bit.
cues.zh: 現在需要先看看資料，開始稍微清理一下。

cues.en: So we have a matrix, so I'm going to start visualizing the data by making an image, so I'll use imagesc.
cues.zh: 我們有一個矩陣，所以先用影像視覺化資料，使用 imagesc。

cues.en: So what we're looking at here is the marriage rates over time.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的是結婚率隨時間的變化。

cues.en: So year or time is on the x-axis and states is on the y-axis.
cues.zh: X 軸是年份或時間，Y 軸是州。

cues.en: So each one of these rows corresponds to a different state.
cues.zh: 每一列都對應一個不同的州。

cues.en: And then the color coding is the number, the counts of marriage by 1000 people in that state.
cues.zh: 顏色編碼代表該州每 1,000 人的結婚件數。

cues.en: So you can see there's a couple of elements here that are, looks like they're zero, but in fact these are NaN.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這裡有幾個元素看起來像零，但其實是 NaN。

cues.en: So if we look at this data matrix M, we can see it's mostly numbers, mostly numbers.
cues.zh: 如果看資料矩陣 M，可以看到大多數都是數值。

cues.en: And here's a couple of NaNs, not a numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾個 NaN，也就是非數值。

cues.en: This actually corresponds to the values in the cell where there were no data recorded.
cues.zh: 它們其實對應 cell 中沒有記錄資料的位置。

cues.en: So it's just a bunch of dash lines here.
cues.zh: 這裡就只是一連串破折號。

cues.en: In MATLAB, those got imported as NaNs.
cues.zh: 在 MATLAB 中，這些被匯入成 NaN。

cues.en: So we need to fix this somehow.
cues.zh: 因此，需要用某種方式處理。

cues.en: We need to interpolate the missing data values.
cues.zh: 需要插補遺失的資料值。

cues.en: Now I've discussed dealing with missing data previously in this course.
cues.zh: 本課程先前已經討論過如何處理遺失資料。

cues.en: So we have a variety of options for how to deal with the missing data.
cues.zh: 我們有多種處理遺失資料的選擇。

cues.en: I chose, after some thinking about it, I chose to replace each missing data value with the column median.
cues.zh: 思考之後，我選擇用該欄的中位數，替換每一個遺失值。

cues.en: So what does that mean, that means, so these are the columns year by year.
cues.zh: 這是什麼意思？這些欄分別是各個年份。

cues.en: So this missing data value here, this dark blue data value here, I'm going to replace that NaN with the median
cues.zh: 因此，這裡這個遺失值，也就是深藍色的資料值，我會把這個 NaN 替換成

cues.en: from all of the other states from this particular year.
cues.zh: 這個特定年份中，其他所有州的中位數。

cues.en: So that is just a choice that I made.
cues.zh: 這只是我做的一個選擇。

cues.en: You could also do it by row median.
cues.zh: 你也可以使用列中位數。

cues.en: So you would replace this by the median across all of the years from this particular state.
cues.zh: 也就是用這個特定州在所有年份的中位數來替換。

cues.en: Of course, you could also use the mean instead of the median, now, you know, I don't know that this is the best way to fix this problem.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以用平均值而不是中位數；我並不知道這是否是處理這個問題的最佳方式，

cues.en: That the column median is the best way to do this.
cues.zh: 也不知道欄中位數是否是最好的做法。

cues.en: This was a decision that I made based on the assumption that all of the states are going to be roughly similar
cues.zh: 這項決定是根據一個假設，也就是各州大致會相似，

cues.en: over states within each year.
cues.zh: 在每個年份內，各州彼此大致相似。

cues.en: Furthermore, I saw that because there are successive values that are missing, then replacing the NaNs with the row median is going to give me identical values
cues.zh: 另外，我看到有連續幾個值遺失，所以如果用列中位數替換 NaN，就會得到相同的值，

cues.en: here for, you know, four successive data points here and two successive data points here.
cues.zh: 例如這裡四個連續資料點，以及這裡兩個連續資料點。

cues.en: Anyway, the point is that there's multiple ways to deal with this, and I couldn't confidently say for sure that the column median is absolutely hands down the only appropriate way
cues.zh: 總之，重點是有多種處理方式，我不能很有把握地說，欄中位數絕對是唯一適當的方式，

cues.en: to replace the missing data.
cues.zh: 可以用來替換遺失資料。

cues.en: Okay, so I just ran this code, and now I'm going to rerun this code here, which creates the new image.
cues.zh: 我剛執行完這段程式，現在重新執行這裡的程式，產生新的影像。

cues.en: So now it looks pretty nice.
cues.zh: 現在看起來很不錯。

cues.en: You can also see, and it already looks like the values are going down over time, the colors are getting less bright.
cues.zh: 也可以看到，數值似乎已經隨時間下降，顏色越來越不明亮。

cues.en: So I wanted to have a closer look at that.
cues.zh: 因此，我想仔細看看。

cues.en: So in a new figure, I'm going to plot basically all these data, but as line plots.
cues.zh: 在新的圖中，我要把基本上所有這些資料，改畫成折線圖。

cues.en: So now you see again over time, but each line now corresponds to a different state.
cues.zh: 現在一樣是時間變化，但每條線對應一個不同的州。

cues.en: And (chuckles) clearly something is unusual about this state.
cues.zh: 顯然，這個州有些不尋常。

cues.en: Now, from this plot, we don't know which state this is, we're gonna get back to that later.
cues.zh: 從這張圖還不知道這是哪個州，稍後會再回來看。

cues.en: Okay, But so all of the states had very different, or not all of 'em, but there were different ranges across these different states.
cues.zh: 各州的範圍都非常不同；也不是每個都不同，但不同州之間確實有不同的數值範圍。

cues.en: So therefore I thought it might be interesting to look at the data z-scored.
cues.zh: 因此，我想把資料轉成 Z 分數來看，可能會很有意思。

cues.en: So I z-scored the data over time within each state, and that's what you can see here.
cues.zh: 我在各州內沿時間將資料轉成 Z 分數，這就是這裡看到的結果。

cues.en: So now that just helps me zoom into the trends.
cues.zh: 這能幫助我更仔細看趨勢。

cues.en: So now what you see is that each state, all of these states, look like they're going down over time.
cues.zh: 現在你可以看到，每個州，所有這些州，似乎都隨時間下降。

cues.en: So the marriage rates appear to be declining over time.
cues.zh: 因此，結婚率看來正在隨時間下降。

cues.en: Now, whether that is a statistically significant decline, we don't know yet.
cues.zh: 但這個下降在統計上是否顯著，我們還不知道。

cues.en: In fact, that's gonna be one of the things I'm going to test statistically in a few videos from now.
cues.zh: 事實上，這就是再過幾部影片後，我會用統計檢定的事情之一。

cues.en: But it's certainly, you know, you certainly get the sense that the marriage rates are going down over time across all of the states.
cues.zh: 但你確實會覺得，各州的結婚率似乎都隨時間下降。

cues.en: Even though that might not necessarily be visible looking at this plot because of the scaling.
cues.zh: 即使因為尺度關係，從這張圖上未必看得出來。

cues.en: Okay, and then I want you to notice that the x-axis is non-constant.
cues.zh: 接著，我想請你注意，X 軸的間距並不固定。

cues.en: So it's monotonic, but it is not linear.
cues.zh: 它是單調的，但不是線性的。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is plotting the average over all the states, and I'm putting a marker at each data point.
cues.zh: 這裡我畫的是所有州的平均，並在每個資料點放一個標記。

cues.en: So you see that, you know, we're missing some years here.
cues.zh: 因此，你會看到這裡少了一些年份。

cues.en: So from '99 up to 2019, we have one data point each year, but we're missing some data values between 1990 and 1995 and between '95 and '99.
cues.zh: 1999 年到 2019 年，每年都有一個資料點，但 1990 到 1995，以及 1995 到 1999 之間，少了一些資料值。

cues.en: Okay, so here's an interesting thought question.
cues.zh: 這裡有個有趣的思考問題。

cues.en: Is this, so by this I mean averaging over states, is this the same as the US average?
cues.zh: 這個，也就是對各州取平均，等不等於美國的平均？

cues.en: So if we were to just get the marriage data over the entire US, ignoring states, is that going to be exactly the same as getting the marriage data within each state
cues.zh: 如果直接取得整個美國的結婚資料，忽略州別，會不會恰好等於取得各州的結婚資料，

cues.en: and then averaging over all the states?
cues.zh: 再對所有州取平均？

cues.en: If you would like to pause the video and think about the answer, then please do so.
cues.zh: 如果想暫停影片思考答案，請先暫停。

cues.en: So the answer is yes.
cues.zh: 答案是會。

cues.en: Averaging the individual lines together actually is the same as the US average, the total population average.
cues.zh: 把各條線取平均，其實就等於美國平均，也就是全體人口平均。

cues.en: Now, that might seem a little strange at first, because we are averaging together all of these 50 different lines corresponding to 50 different states, or 51 including DC.
cues.zh: 一開始，這可能有點奇怪，因為我們平均的是 50 條不同的線，對應 50 個州；包括特區就是 51。

cues.en: Because each state, you know, different states have wildly different populations.
cues.zh: 因為各州的人口數差異非常大。

cues.en: For example, you know, Hawaii versus California.
cues.zh: 例如夏威夷與加州。

cues.en: Populations are totally different.
cues.zh: 人口數完全不同。

cues.en: However, in this dataset, all of the marriages are normalized according to population.
cues.zh: 不過，在這個資料集中，所有結婚數都已按人口數正規化。

cues.en: So number of marriages per 1000 individuals within each state, so because of that normalization step, it actually is appropriate to compute a simple average
cues.zh: 也就是每個州每 1,000 人的結婚件數；因為這個正規化步驟，對所有州的資料計算簡單平均，

cues.en: across the data from all the states.
cues.zh: 其實是適當的。

cues.en: And that gives us the equivalence to the US total population average.
cues.zh: 這就會得到與美國全體人口平均相等的結果。

cues.en: Okay, so then just out of curiosity, I wanted to go back to figure one and redraw this image using the zscore data.
cues.zh: 接著，出於好奇，我想回到第一張圖，用 Z 分數資料重畫這張影像。

cues.en: So redraw all these data, and I think now, you know, it also makes it a little bit clearer, it's a little easier to see that there's a general decline in marriage rates across all the states.
cues.zh: 重畫所有資料後，我覺得更清楚了，更容易看出各州結婚率整體下降的情況。

cues.en: So brighter colors up here, hotter colors and cooler colors over here to the right as we go later on in time.
cues.zh: 這邊是較亮、較暖的顏色，往右、隨時間推進，則變成較冷的顏色。

cues.en: Okay, so now I wanted to make a bar plot of the average marriage rate.
cues.zh: 現在，我想畫平均結婚率的長條圖。

cues.en: So this is, again, averaging over marriage, but now I'm averaging over the second dimension, which is time or years.
cues.zh: 這次一樣對結婚資料取平均，但現在沿著第二個維度，也就是時間或年份取平均。

cues.en: So compute the average marriage rate of each state over, you know, this 30 year period.
cues.zh: 計算每個州在這 30 年期間的平均結婚率。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna sort them.
cues.zh: 接著排序。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm getting the sorting index here is because I want a bar plot that is sorted according to the marriage rate.
cues.zh: 取得排序索引的原因，是我想讓長條圖按照結婚率排序。

cues.en: So now you can see that the x-axis is not, you know, it's not alphabetical, it's not the same order as the original data.
cues.zh: 因此，你可以看到，X 軸不是按字母排列，也不是原始資料的順序。

cues.en: They're sorted according to marriage rate.
cues.zh: 它們是依照結婚率排序。

cues.en: And look at this huge marriage rate in Nevada here.
cues.zh: 看看內華達州這裡非常高的結婚率。

cues.en: So this corresponds to this line that we see up here.
cues.zh: 它對應的就是這裡看到的那條線。

cues.en: So this is Nevada, clearly an unusual data point.
cues.zh: 所以這是內華達州，顯然是個不尋常的資料點。

cues.en: Now the question is, is this a real data point that just happens to be unusual, or is this a mistake?
cues.zh: 問題是，這個真實資料點只是剛好不尋常，還是它有錯？

cues.en: You know, maybe this was a data entry error, someone who was creating this dataset made a mistake and then this is not a valid data point.
cues.zh: 例如，可能是資料輸入錯誤，建立資料集的人弄錯了，導致它不是有效的資料點。

cues.en: Well, to look into this, I did some Google searching and I was Googling for Nevada marriage rates and US state with the highest marriage rate.
cues.zh: 為了調查，我用 Google 搜尋內華達州結婚率，以及美國結婚率最高的州。

cues.en: And I found multiple websites confirmed that this data point is actually valid.
cues.zh: 我找到多個網站，確認這個資料點確實有效。

cues.en: Now I don't know the reason for this.
cues.zh: 但我不知道原因。

cues.en: Maybe it's because of Las Vegas, lots of people getting married in Las Vegas.
cues.zh: 也許是因為拉斯維加斯，很多人在那裡結婚。

cues.en: But I do believe that this is a valid data point.
cues.zh: 但我確實相信這是有效的資料點。

cues.en: It's certainly unusual, but it is valid.
cues.zh: 它確實不尋常，但有效。

cues.en: We have no reason to kick out this data point, okay?
cues.zh: 我們沒有理由剔除這個資料點。

cues.en: But the main thing I'm, I want to express here is that when you see an unusual data point or, you know, an entire row of data, you should be immediately suspicious.
cues.zh: 我想表達的重點是，看到不尋常的資料點，或一整列不尋常的資料時，應該立刻提高警覺。

cues.en: That doesn't mean that it's wrong, it doesn't mean that you need to remove these data from the dataset, but it does mean that you need to look into this further to determine
cues.zh: 這不表示它有錯，也不表示需要把它們從資料集中移除；但表示你需要進一步調查，判斷

cues.en: whether there might have been a mistake or whether these are real data.
cues.zh: 是否可能出了錯，還是這些是真實資料。

cues.en: Okay, so that was this question here actually.
cues.zh: 這其實就是這裡的問題。

cues.en: Is Nevada a non-representative data point, which means it's still valid, or is this an error?
cues.zh: 內華達州是個不具代表性、但仍有效的資料點，還是一項錯誤？

cues.en: Okay, so then, you know, I was thinking again about how a lot of these states look really similar.
cues.zh: 接著，我又想到許多州看起來都很相似。

cues.en: So I was curious to see a correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 因此，我想看看相關矩陣。

cues.en: I wanna see how all these different states, these 50 states, plus D.C., how they are correlated with each other over time.
cues.zh: 我想看這些不同的州，50 個州加上特區，隨時間變化時彼此的相關程度。

cues.en: So I'm making an image of the correlation matrix of the marriage data, and that looks like this.
cues.zh: 於是把結婚資料的相關矩陣畫成影像，看起來是這樣。

cues.en: Now, one thing you have to keep in mind here is that MATLAB is actually not printing these years correctly.
cues.zh: 這裡有一點需要注意，MATLAB 其實沒有正確顯示這些年份。

cues.en: MATLAB is printing these linearly.
cues.zh: MATLAB 是用線性方式顯示。

cues.en: So we got five ticks in between 1990 and 1995 when in fact, or you know, nine cells, when in fact 1995 is this data point here.
cues.zh: 因此，1990 到 1995 之間有五個刻度，或者說九個格子，但 1995 其實是這裡這個資料點。

cues.en: And then this data point here actually corresponds to 1999, and then we go with yearly increases up to 2019.
cues.zh: 接著，這個資料點其實對應 1999 年，之後才是每年增加，一直到 2019 年。

cues.en: So I'm not gonna worry about that, but just to mention that to you.
cues.zh: 我不打算處理這點，只是提醒你。

cues.en: Okay, so it's pretty interesting to look at this correlation plot.
cues.zh: 看這張相關圖很有意思。

cues.en: Essentially this tells us that neighboring years are pretty strongly correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 基本上，它告訴我們，相鄰年份彼此有很強的相關。

cues.en: So the marriage rates over different states in the year 2005 is really strongly correlated with the marriage rates over different states in the year 2006.
cues.zh: 例如，2005 年各州的結婚率，與 2006 年各州的結婚率高度相關。

cues.en: Now, that's not that surprising, but when you look at this correlation matrix, it kind of looks like the correlation drops off to something small in, you know, as you get to 30 years apart.
cues.zh: 這並不太意外，但看這張相關矩陣，似乎年份相距達 30 年時，相關就降到很小。

cues.en: So correlation between marriage rates in 1990 and 2019 seem to be really small.
cues.zh: 也就是 1990 年與 2019 年的結婚率，相關似乎很小。

cues.en: But, you know, what does small mean?
cues.zh: 但「小」到底是什麼意思？

cues.en: We don't have any way of interpreting these numbers because we don't have a color bar here.
cues.zh: 我們無法解讀這些數值，因為這裡沒有色條。

cues.en: So let's add a color bar, and then we see that, in fact, these are all super strongly correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 加上色條後，就發現其實所有年份彼此的相關都超級強。

cues.en: The weakest correlation here is, like, .9.
cues.zh: 這裡最弱的相關大約是 0.9。

cues.en: So these are really, really strongly correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 因此，它們彼此的相關真的非常、非常強。

cues.en: You can see that another way, you know, it's useful to visualize the same data in multiple ways.
cues.zh: 你也可以用另一種方式看；用多種方式視覺化相同資料很有用。

cues.en: I'm gonna plot the correlation matrix as a bunch of little circles, and then you see that all these correlations are really, really, really strong.
cues.zh: 我要把相關矩陣畫成一堆小圓圈，接著就會看到，所有相關都非常、非常強。

cues.en: So we can draw this correlation matrix again.
cues.zh: 因此，我們可以再畫出這個相關矩陣。

cues.en: And, yeah, even over 30 years of time, the correlations of marriage rates over the different states is really, really strong.
cues.zh: 即使跨越 30 年，各州結婚率的相關仍然非常強。

cues.en: Okay, so based on this correlation map, I was actually curious to know whether these are really different components.
cues.zh: 根據這張相關圖，我很好奇，它們是否真的是不同的成分。

cues.en: You know, how many features are actually present in this dataset?
cues.zh: 這個資料集中，究竟有多少特徵？

cues.en: Is there really just one feature that is this general decline in marriage rates over states, or are there some other patterns in the data that we can extract?
cues.zh: 真的只有一個特徵，也就是各州結婚率普遍下降，還是能從資料中萃取出其他模式？

cues.en: Well, to answer that kind of a question, you would perform a principle components analysis.
cues.zh: 要回答這類問題，可以執行主成分分析。

cues.en: So here I did A PCA, of course I've talked about PCA before in the course.
cues.zh: 這裡我做了 PCA，當然，課程先前已經談過 PCA。

cues.en: And then I just made a plot of the- a scree plot of the eigenvalues, which is the explained variance of the data for each component.
cues.zh: 接著，把特徵值畫成陡坡圖，也就是每個成分所解釋的資料變異數。

cues.en: And you see that the entire dataset can be explained by one component accounting for over 98% of the variance.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，整個資料集可以由一個成分解釋，它占超過 98% 的變異數。

cues.en: The second largest component is 1.2% of the variance.
cues.zh: 第二大的成分占 1.2% 的變異數。

cues.en: So pretty much all of the data in this entire dataset is really just accounted for by one pattern, one general feature of the data,
cues.zh: 因此，整個資料集幾乎所有資料，真的都能由一個模式、一個整體特徵來解釋，

cues.en: and that is this decline over time.
cues.zh: 也就是隨時間下降。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm not gonna do any other analysis with the PCA.
cues.zh: 我不會再做其他 PCA 分析。

cues.en: I was just curious to see what the scree plot would look like.
cues.zh: 只是好奇陡坡圖會長什麼樣子。

cues.en: Okay, so that was it for importing the marriage data.
cues.zh: 以上就是匯入結婚資料的部分。

cues.en: And now we have to repeat this for the divorce data, that's coming up in the next video.
cues.zh: 現在必須對離婚資料重做一次，下一部影片就會進行。
